reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes Mn-free CrCoNi is equiatomic (it is CrCoNi, not CrCoNi with equal parts) and overstates the role of magnetic frustration in raising SFE, when literature shows CrCoNi already has lower SFE and more transformation than CrMnFeCoNi, making the proposed mechanism physically questionable.
reasons.testability: The proposed test with in situ XRD, TEM, and XMCD is well-defined and would directly measure the predicted transformation differences, providing a clear falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a known difference but is built on a flawed premise (Mn-free equiatomic CrCoNi) and a mechanism that contradicts established SFE trends, so it would misdirect research effort.
